22211.label: Hosea 1:1
22211.text: The word of Jehovah that occurred to Ho·seʹa the son of Be·eʹri in the days of Uz·ziʹah, Joʹtham, Aʹhaz [and] Hez·e·kiʹah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jer·o·boʹam the son of Joʹash, the king of Israel.

22212.label: Hosea 1:2
22212.text: There was a start of the word of Jehovah by Ho·seʹa, and Jehovah proceeded to say to Ho·seʹa: “Go, take to yourself a wife of fornication and children of fornication, because by fornication the land positively turns from following Jehovah.”

22213.label: Hosea 1:3
22213.text: And he proceeded to go and take Goʹmer the daughter of Dib·laʹim, so that she became pregnant and in time bore to him a son.

22214.label: Hosea 1:4
22214.text: And Jehovah went on to say to him: “Call his name Jezʹre·el, for yet a little while and I must hold an accounting for the acts of bloodshed of Jezʹre·el against the house of Jeʹhu, and I must cause the royal rule of the house of Israel to cease.

22215.label: Hosea 1:5
22215.text: And it must occur in that day that I must break the bow of Israel in the low plain of Jezʹre·el.”

22216.label: Hosea 1:6
22216.text: And she proceeded to become pregnant another time and to give birth to a daughter. And He went on to say to him: “Call her name Lo-ru·haʹmah, for I shall no more show mercy again to the house of Israel, because I shall positively take them away.

22217.label: Hosea 1:7
22217.text: But to the house of Judah I shall show mercy, and I will save them by Jehovah their God; but I shall not save them by a bow or by a sword or by war, by horses or by horsemen.”

22218.label: Hosea 1:8
22218.text: And she gradually weaned Lo-ru·haʹmah, and she proceeded to become pregnant and give birth to a son.

22219.label: Hosea 1:9
22219.text: So He said: “Call his name Lo-amʹmi, because YOU men are not my people and I myself shall prove to be not YOURS.

22220.label: Hosea 1:10
22220.text: “And the number of the sons of Israel must become like the grains of the sand of the sea that cannot be measured or numbered. And it must occur that in the place in which it used to be said to them, ‘YOU men are not my people,’ it will be said to them, ‘The sons of the living God.’

22221.label: Hosea 1:11
22221.text: And the sons of Judah and the sons of Israel will certainly be collected together into a unity and will actually set up for themselves one head and go up out of the land, because great will be the day of Jezʹre·el.

22222.label: Hosea 2:1
22222.text: “SAY to YOUR brothers, ‘My people!’ and to YOUR sisters, ‘O woman shown mercy!’

22223.label: Hosea 2:2
22223.text: Carry on a legal case with YOUR mother; carry on a legal case, for she is not my wife and I am not her husband. And she should put away her fornication from before herself and her acts of adultery from between her breasts,

22224.label: Hosea 2:3
22224.text: that I may not strip her naked and actually place her as in the day of her being born, and actually set her like a wilderness and place her like a waterless land and put her to death with thirst.

22225.label: Hosea 2:4
22225.text: And to her sons I shall not show mercy, for they are the sons of fornication.

22226.label: Hosea 2:5
22226.text: For their mother has committed fornication. She that was pregnant with them has acted shamefully, for she has said, ‘I want to go after those passionately loving me, those giving my bread and my water, my wool and my linen, my oil and my drink.’

22227.label: Hosea 2:6
22227.text: “Therefore here I am hedging your way about with thorns; and I will heap up a stone wall against her, so that her own roadways she will not find.

22228.label: Hosea 2:7
22228.text: And she will actually chase after her passionate lovers, but she will not overtake them; and she will certainly look for them, but she will not find [them]. And she will have to say, ‘I want to go and return to my husband, the first one, for I had it better at that time than now.’

22229.label: Hosea 2:8
22229.text: But she herself did not recognize that it was I who had given to her the grain and the sweet wine and the oil, and that I had made silver itself abound for her, and gold, [which] they made use of for Baʹal.

22230.label: Hosea 2:9
22230.text: “‘Therefore I shall turn back and certainly take away my grain in its time and my sweet wine in its season, and I will snatch away my wool and my linen for covering her nakedness.

22231.label: Hosea 2:10
22231.text: And now I shall uncover her private parts to the eyes of her passionate lovers, and there will be no man to snatch her out of my hand.

22232.label: Hosea 2:11
22232.text: And I shall certainly cause all her exultation, her festival, her new moon and her sabbath and her every festal season to cease.

22233.label: Hosea 2:12
22233.text: And I will lay desolate her vine and her fig tree, of which she has said: “They are a gift to me, which my passionate lovers have given to me”; and I will set them as a forest, and the wild beast of the field will certainly devour them.

22234.label: Hosea 2:13
22234.text: And I will hold an accounting against her for the days of the Baʹal images to which she kept making sacrificial smoke, when she kept decking herself with her ring and her ornament and kept going after her passionate lovers, and I was the one that she forgot,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

22235.label: Hosea 2:14
22235.text: “‘Therefore here I am prevailing upon her, and I will cause her to go into the wilderness, and I will speak to her heart.

22236.label: Hosea 2:15
22236.text: And I will give her her vineyards from then onward, and the low plain of Aʹchor as an entrance to hope; and she will certainly answer there as in the days of her youth and as in the day of her coming up out of the land of Egypt.

22237.label: Hosea 2:16
22237.text: And it must occur in that day,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘that you will call [me] My husband, and you will no longer call me My owner.’

22238.label: Hosea 2:17
22238.text: “‘And I will remove the names of the Baʹal images from her mouth, and they will no longer be remembered by their name.

22239.label: Hosea 2:18
22239.text: And for them I shall certainly conclude a covenant in that day in connection with the wild beast of the field and with the flying creature of the heavens and the creeping thing of the ground, and the bow and the sword and war I shall break out of the land, and I will make them lie down in security.

22240.label: Hosea 2:19
22240.text: And I will engage you to me for time indefinite, and I will engage you to me in righteousness and in justice and in loving-kindness and in mercies.

22241.label: Hosea 2:20
22241.text: And I will engage you to me in faithfulness; and you will certainly know Jehovah.’

22242.label: Hosea 2:21
22242.text: “‘And it must occur in that day that I shall answer,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘I shall answer the heavens, and they, for their part, will answer the earth;

22243.label: Hosea 2:22
22243.text: and the earth, for its part, will answer the grain and the sweet wine and the oil; and they, for their part, will answer Jezʹre·el [‘God will sow seed’].

22244.label: Hosea 2:23
22244.text: And I shall certainly sow her like seed for me in the earth, and I will show mercy to her who was not shown mercy, and I will say to those not my people: “You are my people”; and they, for their part, will say: “[You are] my God.”’”

22245.label: Hosea 3:1
22245.text: And Jehovah went on to say to me: “Go once again, love a woman loved by a companion and committing adultery, as in the case of Jehovah’s love for the sons of Israel while they are turning to other gods and are loving raisin cakes.”

22246.label: Hosea 3:2
22246.text: And I proceeded to purchase her for myself for fifteen silver [pieces] and a hoʹmer measure of barley and a half-hoʹmer of barley.

22247.label: Hosea 3:3
22247.text: Then I said to her: “For many days you will dwell as mine. You must not commit fornication, and you must not come to belong to [another] man; and I also will be for you.”

22248.label: Hosea 3:4
22248.text: It is because for many days the sons of Israel will dwell without a king and without a prince and without a sacrifice and without a pillar and without an ephʹod and teraphim.

22249.label: Hosea 3:5
22249.text: Afterwards the sons of Israel will come back and certainly look for Jehovah their God, and for David their king; and they will certainly come quivering to Jehovah and to his goodness in the final part of the days.

22250.label: Hosea 4:1
22250.text: Hear the word of Jehovah, O sons of Israel, for Jehovah has a legal case with the inhabitants of the land, for there is no truth nor loving-kindness nor knowledge of God in the land.

22251.label: Hosea 4:2
22251.text: There are the pronouncing of curses and practicing of deception and murdering and stealing and committing of adultery that have broken forth, and acts of bloodshed have touched other acts of bloodshed.

22252.label: Hosea 4:3
22252.text: That is why the land will mourn and every inhabitant in it will have to fade away with the wild beast of the field and with the flying creature of the heavens, and even the fishes of the sea themselves will be gathered [in death].

22253.label: Hosea 4:4
22253.text: “However, let no man contend, neither let a man reprove, as your people are like those who are contending against a priest.

22254.label: Hosea 4:5
22254.text: And you will certainly stumble in the daytime, and even a prophet must stumble with you, as at night. And I will put your mother to silence.

22255.label: Hosea 4:6
22255.text: My people will certainly be silenced, because there is no knowledge. Because the knowledge is what you yourself have rejected, I shall also reject you from serving as a priest to me; and [because] you keep forgetting the law of your God, I shall forget your sons, even I.

22256.label: Hosea 4:7
22256.text: In proportion to the multitude of them, so they have sinned against me. My own glory they have exchanged for mere dishonor.

22257.label: Hosea 4:8
22257.text: The sin of my people is what they keep devouring, and to their error they keep lifting up their soul.

22258.label: Hosea 4:9
22258.text: “And it will have to become for the people the same as for the priest; and I shall certainly hold an accounting against them for their ways; and their dealings I shall bring back upon them.

22259.label: Hosea 4:10
22259.text: And they will actually eat, but will not get satisfied. They will actually treat [women] as harlots; but they will not increase, because they have left off paying regard to Jehovah himself.

22260.label: Hosea 4:11
22260.text: Fornication and wine and sweet wine are what take away good motive.

22261.label: Hosea 4:12
22261.text: Of their wooden [idol] my own people keep inquiring, and their own [hand] staff keeps telling them; because the very spirit of fornication has caused them to wander off, and by fornication they go out from under their God.

22262.label: Hosea 4:13
22262.text: On the tops of the mountains they sacrifice, and on the hills they make sacrificial smoke, under massive tree and storax tree and big tree, because its shade is good. That is why YOUR daughters commit fornication and YOUR own daughters-in-law commit adultery.

22263.label: Hosea 4:14
22263.text: “I shall not hold an accounting against YOUR daughters because they commit fornication, and against YOUR daughters-in-law because they commit adultery. For, as to the [men], it is with the harlots that they get off to themselves, and with the female temple prostitutes that they sacrifice; and a people [that] does not understand will be trodden down.

22264.label: Hosea 4:15
22264.text: Although you are committing fornication, O Israel, let not Judah become guilty, and do not YOU people come to Gilʹgal, neither go up to Beth-aʹven nor swear ‘As Jehovah is alive!’

22265.label: Hosea 4:16
22265.text: For, like a stubborn cow, Israel has become stubborn. Is it now that Jehovah will shepherd them like a young ram in a roomy place?

22266.label: Hosea 4:17
22266.text: Eʹphra·im is joined with idols. Let him be to himself!

22267.label: Hosea 4:18
22267.text: Their wheat beer being gone, they have positively treated [woman] as a harlot. Her shielders have positively loved dishonor.

22268.label: Hosea 4:19
22268.text: A wind has wrapped her up in its wings. And they will be ashamed of their sacrifices.”

22269.label: Hosea 5:1
22269.text: “Hear this, O priests, and pay attention, O house of Israel, and YOU, O house of the king, give ear, for with YOU people the judgment has to do; because a trap is what YOU have become to Mizʹpah and as a net spread over Taʹbor.

22270.label: Hosea 5:2
22270.text: And in slaughter work those falling away have gone deep down, and I was an exhortation to all of them.

22271.label: Hosea 5:3
22271.text: I personally have known Eʹphra·im, and Israel itself has not been hidden from me. For now, O Eʹphra·im, you have treated [women] like harlots; Israel has defiled itself.

22272.label: Hosea 5:4
22272.text: Their dealings do not permit of a returning to their God, because there is a spirit of fornication in the midst of them; and Jehovah himself they have not acknowledged.

22273.label: Hosea 5:5
22273.text: And the pride of Israel has testified to his face; and Israel and Eʹphra·im themselves are made to stumble in their error. Judah has also stumbled with them.

22274.label: Hosea 5:6
22274.text: With their flock and with their herd they proceeded to go and look for Jehovah, but they could not find [him]. He had drawn away from them.

22275.label: Hosea 5:7
22275.text: With Jehovah himself they have dealt treacherously, for it is to strange sons that they have become father. Now a month will devour them with their portions.

22276.label: Hosea 5:8
22276.text: “BLOW a horn in Gibʹe·ah, a trumpet in Raʹmah! SHOUT a war cry at Beth-aʹven —after you, O Benjamin!

22277.label: Hosea 5:9
22277.text: O Eʹphra·im, a mere object of astonishment you will become in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I have made known trustworthy words.

22278.label: Hosea 5:10
22278.text: The princes of Judah have become just like those moving back a boundary. Upon them I shall pour out my fury just like water.

22279.label: Hosea 5:11
22279.text: Eʹphra·im is oppressed, crushed in justice, for he had taken it upon himself to walk after his adversary.

22280.label: Hosea 5:12
22280.text: And I was like the moth to Eʹphra·im and just like rottenness to the house of Judah.

22281.label: Hosea 5:13
22281.text: “And Eʹphra·im got to see his sickness, and Judah his ulcer. And Eʹphra·im proceeded to go to As·syrʹi·a and send to a great king. But that one himself was unable to give healing to YOU people, and he could not take from YOU an ulcer with any cure.

22282.label: Hosea 5:14
22282.text: For I shall be like a young lion to Eʹphra·im and like a maned young lion to the house of Judah. I, I myself shall tear to pieces and I shall go [and] carry off, and there will be no deliverer.

22283.label: Hosea 5:15
22283.text: I shall go, I will return to my place until they bear their guilt; and they will certainly seek my face. When they are in sore straits, they will seek me.”

22284.label: Hosea 6:1
22284.text: “Come, YOU people, and do let us return to Jehovah, for he himself has torn in pieces but he will heal us. He kept striking, but he will bind us up.

22285.label: Hosea 6:2
22285.text: He will make us alive after two days. On the third day he will make us get up, and we shall live before him.

22286.label: Hosea 6:3
22286.text: And we will know, we will pursue to know Jehovah. Like dawn, his going forth is firmly established. And he will come in like a pouring rain to us; like a spring rain that saturates [the] earth.”

22287.label: Hosea 6:4
22287.text: “What shall I do to you, O Eʹphra·im? What shall I do to you, O Judah, when the loving-kindness of YOU people is like the morning clouds and like the dew that early goes away?

22288.label: Hosea 6:5
22288.text: That is why I shall have to hew [them] by the prophets; I shall have to kill them by the sayings of my mouth. And the judgments upon you will be as the light that goes forth.

22289.label: Hosea 6:6
22289.text: For in loving-kindness I have taken delight, and not in sacrifice; and in the knowledge of God rather than in whole burnt offerings.

22290.label: Hosea 6:7
22290.text: But they themselves, like earthling man, have overstepped [the] covenant. There is where they have dealt treacherously with me.

22291.label: Hosea 6:8
22291.text: Gilʹe·ad is a town of practicers of what is harmful; their footprints are blood.

22292.label: Hosea 6:9
22292.text: And as in the lying in wait for a man, the association of priests are marauding bands. By the wayside they commit murder at Sheʹchem, because they have carried on nothing but loose conduct.

22293.label: Hosea 6:10
22293.text: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There there is fornication on the part of Eʹphra·im. Israel has defiled itself.

22294.label: Hosea 6:11
22294.text: Furthermore, O Judah, a harvest has been fixed for you, when I gather back the captive ones of my people.”

22295.label: Hosea 7:1
22295.text: “At the time that I would bring healing to Israel, the error of Eʹphra·im is also actually uncovered, and the bad things of Sa·marʹi·a; for they have practiced falsehood, and a thief himself comes in; a marauder band actually makes a dash on the outside.

22296.label: Hosea 7:2
22296.text: And they do not say to their own heart that all their badness I will remember. Now their dealings have surrounded them. In front of my face they have come to be.

22297.label: Hosea 7:3
22297.text: By their badness they make [the] king rejoice, and, by their deceptions, princes.

22298.label: Hosea 7:4
22298.text: All of them are adulterers, like a furnace set burning by a baker, [who] ceases poking after kneading dough until it is leavened.

22299.label: Hosea 7:5
22299.text: On the day of our king, princes have sickened themselves —there is a rage because of wine. He has drawn his hand along with deriders.

22300.label: Hosea 7:6
22300.text: For they have brought their heart near as to a furnace; it is burning inside them. All night long their baker is sleeping; by morning [the furnace] is burning as with a flaming fire.

22301.label: Hosea 7:7
22301.text: They get hot, all of them, like the furnace, and they actually devour their judges. Their own kings have all fallen; none among them is calling out to me.

22302.label: Hosea 7:8
22302.text: “As for Eʹphra·im, it is among the peoples that he personally mingles himself. Eʹphra·im himself has become a round cake not turned on the other side.

22303.label: Hosea 7:9
22303.text: Strangers have eaten up his power, and he himself has not come to know [it]. Also, gray hairs themselves have become white on him, but he himself has not come to know [it].

22304.label: Hosea 7:10
22304.text: And the pride of Israel has testified to his face, and they have not returned to Jehovah their God, nor have they looked for him because of all this.

22305.label: Hosea 7:11
22305.text: And Eʹphra·im proves to be like a simpleminded dove without heart. To Egypt they have called; to As·syrʹi·a they have gone.

22306.label: Hosea 7:12
22306.text: “Whichever way they go, I shall spread out over them my net. Like flying creatures of the heavens I shall bring them down. I shall discipline them in agreement with the report to their assembly.

22307.label: Hosea 7:13
22307.text: Woe to them, for they have fled from me! Despoiling to them, for they have transgressed against me! And I myself proceeded to redeem them, but they themselves have spoken lies even against me.

22308.label: Hosea 7:14
22308.text: And they did not call to me for aid with their heart, although they kept howling on their beds. On account of their grain and sweet wine they kept loafing about; they kept turning against me.

22309.label: Hosea 7:15
22309.text: And I, for my part, did disciplining; I strengthened their arms, but against me they kept scheming what was bad.

22310.label: Hosea 7:16
22310.text: And they proceeded to return, not to anything higher; they had become like a loose bow. By the sword their princes will fall because of the denunciation of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.”

22311.label: Hosea 8:1
22311.text: “To your mouth —a horn! [One comes] like an eagle against the house of Jehovah, for the reason that they have overstepped my covenant, and against my law they have transgressed.

22312.label: Hosea 8:2
22312.text: To me they keep crying, ‘O my God, we, Israel, have known you.’

22313.label: Hosea 8:3
22313.text: “Israel has cast off good. Let one who is an enemy pursue him.

22314.label: Hosea 8:4
22314.text: They themselves have set up kings, but not because of me. They have set up princes, but I did not know [it]. With their silver and their gold they have made for themselves idols, to the end that they may be cut off.

22315.label: Hosea 8:5
22315.text: Your calf has been cast off, O Sa·marʹi·a. My anger has grown hot against them. How long will they be incapable of innocency?

22316.label: Hosea 8:6
22316.text: For from Israel was even this. A mere craftsman made it, and it is not God; because the calf of Sa·marʹi·a will become mere splinters.

22317.label: Hosea 8:7
22317.text: “For it is wind that they keep sowing, and a storm wind is what they will reap. Nothing has standing grain. No sprout produces flour. Should any perhaps produce [it], strangers themselves will swallow it down.

22318.label: Hosea 8:8
22318.text: “Israel must be swallowed down. Now they must come to be among the nations, like a vessel in which there is no delight.

22319.label: Hosea 8:9
22319.text: For they themselves have gone up to As·syrʹi·a, as a zebra isolated to itself. In Eʹphra·im’s case, they have hired lovers.

22320.label: Hosea 8:10
22320.text: Also, although they keep hiring [them] among the nations, I shall now collect them together; and they will be a little while in severe pains because of the burden of king [and] princes.

22321.label: Hosea 8:11
22321.text: “For Eʹphra·im has multiplied altars in order to sin. He has come to have altars in order to sin.

22322.label: Hosea 8:12
22322.text: I proceeded to write for him many things of my law; just like something strange they have been accounted.

22323.label: Hosea 8:13
22323.text: As my gift sacrifices they kept sacrificing flesh, and they kept eating what Jehovah himself took no pleasure in. Now he will remember their error and hold an accounting for their sins. To Egypt they themselves proceeded to return.

22324.label: Hosea 8:14
22324.text: And Israel began forgetting his Maker and building temples; and Judah, for his part, multiplied fortified cities. And I shall certainly send fire into his cities and it must devour the dwelling towers of [each] one.”

22325.label: Hosea 9:1
22325.text: “Do not rejoice, O Israel. Do not act joyful like the peoples. For by fornication you have gone from alongside your God. You have loved gifts of hire on all the threshing floors of grain.

22326.label: Hosea 9:2
22326.text: Threshing floor and winepress do not feed them, and sweet wine itself proves disappointing to her.

22327.label: Hosea 9:3
22327.text: They will not continue dwelling in the land of Jehovah, and Eʹphra·im must return to Egypt, and in As·syrʹi·a they will eat what is unclean.

22328.label: Hosea 9:4
22328.text: They will not continue pouring out wine to Jehovah. And their sacrifices will not be gratifying to him; they are like the bread of times of mourning to them; all those eating it will defile themselves. For their bread is for their own soul; it will not come into the house of Jehovah.

22329.label: Hosea 9:5
22329.text: What will YOU people do in the day of meeting and in the day of the festival of Jehovah?

22330.label: Hosea 9:6
22330.text: For, look! they will have to go because of despoiling. Egypt itself will collect them together; Memʹphis, for its part, will bury them. As for their desirable things of silver, nettles themselves will take possession of them; thorny bushes will be in their tents.

22331.label: Hosea 9:7
22331.text: “The days of being given attention must come; the days of the due payment must come. Those of Israel will know [it]. The prophet will be foolish, the man of inspired expression will be maddened on account of the abundance of your error, even animosity being abundant.”

22332.label: Hosea 9:8
22332.text: The watchman of Eʹphra·im was with my God. As regards a prophet, there is the trap of a birdcatcher on all his ways; there is an animosity in the house of his God.

22333.label: Hosea 9:9
22333.text: They have gone down deep in bringing ruin, as in the days of Gibʹe·ah. He will remember their error; he will give attention to their sins.

22334.label: Hosea 9:10
22334.text: “Like grapes in the wilderness I found Israel. Like the early fig on a fig tree in its beginning I saw the forefathers of YOU people. They themselves went in to Baʹal of Peʹor, and they proceeded to dedicate themselves to the shameful thing, and they came to be disgusting like [the thing of] their love.

22335.label: Hosea 9:11
22335.text: As regards Eʹphra·im, like a flying creature their glory flies away, so that there is no giving birth, and no [pregnant] belly and no conception.

22336.label: Hosea 9:12
22336.text: For although they bring up their sons, I will also bereave them of children so that there will be no man; because—woe also to them when I turn away from them!

22337.label: Hosea 9:13
22337.text: Eʹphra·im, whom I have seen like Tyre planted in a pasture ground, even Eʹphra·im is destined to a bringing out of his sons even to a killer.”

22338.label: Hosea 9:14
22338.text: Give to them, O Jehovah, what you should give. Give them a miscarrying womb and breasts shriveling up.

22339.label: Hosea 9:15
22339.text: “All their badness was in Gilʹgal, for there I had to hate them. On account of the evil of their dealings I shall drive them away from my own house. I will not continue on loving them. All their princes are acting stubborn.

22340.label: Hosea 9:16
22340.text: Eʹphra·im must be struck down. Their very root must dry up. There will be no fruit that they produce. Also, in case they bring to birth, I will even put to death the desirable things of their belly.”

22341.label: Hosea 9:17
22341.text: My God will reject them, for they have not listened to him, and they will become fugitives among the nations.

22342.label: Hosea 10:1
22342.text: “Israel is a degenerating vine. Fruit he keeps putting forth for himself. In proportion to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied [his] altars. In proportion to the goodness of his land, they put up good pillars.

22343.label: Hosea 10:2
22343.text: Their heart has become hypocritical; now they will be found guilty. “There is one who will break their altars; he will despoil their pillars.

22344.label: Hosea 10:3
22344.text: For now they will say, ‘We have no king, for we have not feared Jehovah. And as regards the king, what will he do for us?’

22345.label: Hosea 10:4
22345.text: “They speak words, making false oaths, concluding a covenant; and judgment has sprouted like a poisonous plant in the furrows of the open field.

22346.label: Hosea 10:5
22346.text: For the calf [idol] of Beth-aʹven the residents of Sa·marʹi·a will get frightened; for over it its people will certainly mourn, as well as its foreign-god priests [who] used to be joyful over it, on account of its glory, because it will have gone into exile away from it.

22347.label: Hosea 10:6
22347.text: Even it someone will bring to As·syrʹi·a itself as a gift to a great king. Shame is what Eʹphra·im himself will get, and Israel will be ashamed of its counsel.

22348.label: Hosea 10:7
22348.text: Sa·marʹi·a [and] her king will certainly be silenced, like a snapped-off twig on the surface of waters.

22349.label: Hosea 10:8
22349.text: And the high places of [Beth-]aʹven, the sin of Israel, will actually be annihilated. Thorns and thistles themselves will come up upon their altars. And people will in fact say to the mountains, ‘Cover us!’ and to the hills, ‘Fall over us!’

22350.label: Hosea 10:9
22350.text: “From the days of Gibʹe·ah you have sinned, O Israel. There they stood still. In Gibʹe·ah war against the sons of unrighteousness did not get to overtake them.

22351.label: Hosea 10:10
22351.text: When it is my craving I shall also discipline them. And against them peoples will certainly be gathered when there is a harnessing of them to their two errors.

22352.label: Hosea 10:11
22352.text: “And Eʹphra·im was a trained heifer loving to thresh; and I, for my part, passed over her good-looking neck. I make [someone] ride Eʹphra·im. Judah plows; Jacob harrows for him.

22353.label: Hosea 10:12
22353.text: Sow seed for yourselves in righteousness; reap in accord with loving-kindness. Till for yourselves arable land, when there is time for searching for Jehovah until he comes and gives instruction in righteousness to YOU.

22354.label: Hosea 10:13
22354.text: “YOU people have plowed wickedness. Unrighteousness is what YOU have reaped. YOU have eaten the fruitage of deception, for you have trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty ones.

22355.label: Hosea 10:14
22355.text: And an uproar has risen among your people, and your own fortified cities will all be despoiled, as with the despoiling by Shalʹman of the house of Arʹbel, in the day of battle [when] a mother herself was dashed to pieces alongside [her] own sons.

22356.label: Hosea 10:15
22356.text: In this way one will certainly do to YOU people, O Bethʹel, because of YOUR extreme badness. In the dawn the king of Israel will positively have to be silenced.”

22357.label: Hosea 11:1
22357.text: “When Israel was a boy, then I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.

22358.label: Hosea 11:2
22358.text: “They called them. To that same extent they went away from before them. To the Baʹal images they took up sacrificing, and to the graven images they began making sacrificial smoke.

22359.label: Hosea 11:3
22359.text: But as for me, I taught Eʹphra·im to walk, taking them upon [my] arms; and they did not recognize that I had healed them.

22360.label: Hosea 11:4
22360.text: With the ropes of earthling man I kept drawing them, with the cords of love, so that I became to them as those lifting off a yoke on their jaws, and gently I brought food to [each] one.

22361.label: Hosea 11:5
22361.text: He will not return to the land of Egypt, but As·syrʹi·a will be his king, because they refused to return.

22362.label: Hosea 11:6
22362.text: And a sword will certainly whirl about in his cities and make an end of his bars and devour because of their counsels.

22363.label: Hosea 11:7
22363.text: And my people are tending toward unfaithfulness to me. And upward they call it; no one at all does any rising up.

22364.label: Hosea 11:8
22364.text: “How can I give you up, O Eʹphra·im? [How] can I deliver you up, O Israel? How can I set you as Adʹmah? [How] can I place you like Ze·boiʹim? My heart has changed within me; at the same time my compassions have grown hot.

22365.label: Hosea 11:9
22365.text: I shall not express my burning anger. I shall not bring Eʹphra·im to ruin again, for I am God and not man, the Holy One in the midst of you; and I shall not come in excitement.

22366.label: Hosea 11:10
22366.text: After Jehovah they will walk. Like a lion he will roar; for he himself will roar, and sons will come trembling from the west.

22367.label: Hosea 11:11
22367.text: Like a bird they will come trembling out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of As·syrʹi·a; and I shall certainly make them dwell in their houses,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

22368.label: Hosea 11:12
22368.text: “With lying, Eʹphra·im has surrounded me, and with deception the house of Israel. But Judah is yet roaming with God, and with the Most Holy One he is trustworthy.”

22369.label: Hosea 12:1
22369.text: “Eʹphra·im is feeding on wind and chasing after the east wind all day long. Lying and despoiling are what he multiplies. And a covenant with As·syrʹi·a they conclude, and to Egypt oil itself is brought.

22370.label: Hosea 12:2
22370.text: “And Jehovah has a legal case with Judah, even to hold an accounting against Jacob according to his ways; according to his dealings he will repay him.

22371.label: Hosea 12:3
22371.text: In the belly he seized his brother by the heel, and with his dynamic energy he contended with God.

22372.label: Hosea 12:4
22372.text: And he kept contending with an angel and gradually prevailed. He wept, that he might implore favor for himself.” At Bethʹel He got to find him, and there He began talking with us.

22373.label: Hosea 12:5
22373.text: And Jehovah the God of the armies, Jehovah is his memorial.

22374.label: Hosea 12:6
22374.text: “And as respects you, to your God you should return, keeping loving-kindness and justice; and let there be a hoping in your God constantly.

22375.label: Hosea 12:7
22375.text: As regards [the] tradesman, in his hand are the scales of deception; to defraud is what he has loved.

22376.label: Hosea 12:8
22376.text: And Eʹphra·im keeps saying, ‘Indeed, I have become rich; I have found valuable things for myself. As regards all my toiling, they will find, on my part, no error that is sin.’

22377.label: Hosea 12:9
22377.text: “But I am Jehovah your God from the land of Egypt. Yet I shall make you dwell in the tents as in the days of an appointed time.

22378.label: Hosea 12:10
22378.text: And I spoke to the prophets, and visions I myself multiplied, and by the hand of the prophets I kept making likenesses.

22379.label: Hosea 12:11
22379.text: “With Gilʹe·ad what is uncanny, also untruth, have occurred. In Gilʹgal they have sacrificed even bulls. Moreover, their altars are like piles of stones in the furrows of the open field.

22380.label: Hosea 12:12
22380.text: And Jacob proceeded to run away to the field of Syria, and Israel kept serving for a wife, and for a wife he guarded [sheep].

22381.label: Hosea 12:13
22381.text: And by a prophet Jehovah brought up Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was guarded.

22382.label: Hosea 12:14
22382.text: Eʹphra·im caused offense to bitterness, and his deeds of bloodshed he leaves upon his own self, and his reproach his grand Master will repay to him.”

22383.label: Hosea 13:1
22383.text: “When Eʹphra·im spoke, there was trembling; he himself carried [weight] in Israel. But he proceeded to become guilty in regard to Baʹal and die.

22384.label: Hosea 13:2
22384.text: And now they commit additional sin and make for themselves a molten statue from their silver, idols according to their own understanding, the work of craftsmen, all of it. To them they are saying, ‘Let the sacrificers who are men kiss mere calves.’

22385.label: Hosea 13:3
22385.text: Therefore they will become like the clouds of morning and like the dew that early goes away; like chaff that is stormed away from the threshing floor and like smoke from the [roof] hole.

22386.label: Hosea 13:4
22386.text: “But I am Jehovah your God from the land of Egypt, and there was no God except me that you used to know; and there was no savior but I.

22387.label: Hosea 13:5
22387.text: I myself knew you in the wilderness, in the land of fevers.

22388.label: Hosea 13:6
22388.text: According to their pasturage they also came to be satisfied. They became satisfied and their heart began to be exalted. That is why they forgot me.

22389.label: Hosea 13:7
22389.text: And I shall become to them like a young lion. Like a leopard by [the] way I shall keep looking.

22390.label: Hosea 13:8
22390.text: I shall encounter them like a bear that has lost its cubs, and I shall rip apart the enclosure of their heart. And I shall devour them there like a lion; a wild beast of the field itself will tear them to pieces.

22391.label: Hosea 13:9
22391.text: It will certainly bring you to ruin, O Israel, because it was against me, against your helper.

22392.label: Hosea 13:10
22392.text: “Where, then, is your king, that he may save you in all your cities, and your judges, [concerning] whom you said, ‘Do give me a king and princes’?

22393.label: Hosea 13:11
22393.text: I proceeded to give you a king in my anger, and I shall take [him] away in my fury.

22394.label: Hosea 13:12
22394.text: “The error of Eʹphra·im is wrapped up, his sin is treasured up.

22395.label: Hosea 13:13
22395.text: The labor pangs of a woman giving birth are what will come to him. He is a son not wise, for in season he will not stand still at the breaking forth of sons [from the womb].

22396.label: Hosea 13:14
22396.text: “From the hand of Sheʹol I shall redeem them; from death I shall recover them. Where are your stings, O Death? Where is your destructiveness, O Sheʹol? Compassion itself will be concealed from my eyes.

22397.label: Hosea 13:15
22397.text: “In case he himself as the son of reed plants should show fruitfulness, an east wind, the wind of Jehovah, will come. From a wilderness it is coming up, and it will dry up his well and drain his spring. That one will pillage the treasure of all desirable articles.

22398.label: Hosea 13:16
22398.text: “Sa·marʹi·a will be held guilty, for she is actually rebellious against her God. By the sword they will fall. Their own children will be dashed to pieces, and their pregnant women themselves will be ripped up.”

22399.label: Hosea 14:1
22399.text: “Do come back, O Israel, to Jehovah your God, for you have stumbled in your error.

22400.label: Hosea 14:2
22400.text: Take with yourselves words and come back to Jehovah. Say to him, all YOU people, ‘May you pardon error; and accept what is good, and we will offer in return the young bulls of our lips.

22401.label: Hosea 14:3
22401.text: As·syrʹi·a itself will not save us. Upon horses we shall not ride. And no more shall we say: “O our God!” to the work of our hands, because it is by you that a fatherless boy is shown mercy.’

22402.label: Hosea 14:4
22402.text: “I shall heal their unfaithfulness. I shall love them of [my] own free will, because my anger has turned back from him.

22403.label: Hosea 14:5
22403.text: I shall become like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and will strike his roots like Lebʹa·non.

22404.label: Hosea 14:6
22404.text: His twigs will go forth, and his dignity will become like that of the olive tree, and his fragrance will be like that of Lebʹa·non.

22405.label: Hosea 14:7
22405.text: They will again be dwellers in his shadow. They will grow grain, and will bud like the vine. His memorial will be like the wine of Lebʹa·non.

22406.label: Hosea 14:8
22406.text: “Eʹphra·im [will say], ‘What do I have to do any longer with the idols?’ “I myself shall certainly give an answer and I shall keep looking on him. I am like a luxuriant juniper tree. From me must fruit for you be found.”

22407.label: Hosea 14:9
22407.text: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Discreet, that he may know them? For the ways of Jehovah are upright, and the righteous are the ones who will walk in them; but the transgressors are the ones who will stumble in them.
